name: aura-usd-derivative-pipeline
description: Reproducible GPU environment for AURA OpenUSD authoring, USD->GLB conversion and derivative validation. Aligned with the NVIDIA Omniverse DSX Blueprint; Brev is the reproducible compute environment, not a replacement for Omniverse, OpenUSD or DSX.

instance.note: Disk sized for the NVIDIA Data Center OpenUSD Assets Pack plus derivative output.

blender.usage: headless OpenUSD import and glTF 2.0 export
blender.note: Draco encoding stays disabled: the 5.0.1 build aborts inside the Draco encoder. Mesh optimisation is done by gltf-transform.

environmentVariables.AURA_PACK_ARCHIVE: Local path to Datacenter_NVD@10012.zip (licensed NVIDIA pack, never committed).
environmentVariables.AURA_ASSET_OUTPUT: Directory for generated derivatives and evidence.
environmentVariables.AURA_S3_SOURCE_BUCKET: Private bucket for versioned USD masters and dependencies.
environmentVariables.AURA_S3_DERIVATIVE_BUCKET: Controlled bucket for approved browser derivatives.
environmentVariables.AWS_ROLE_ARN: Deployment role assumed for publication. No long-lived keys.

executionStatus.reason: No Brev credentials or execution access are available from this environment. The configuration is reproducible and complete; no Brev run is claimed.
